title.description: Short descriptive title (3-6 words) for file naming

coverImageId.description: Image entity ID for post image

logo.description: Whether to display logo instead of title text in header

buttonLink.description: URL or anchor for the CTA button

sections.description: Optional per-section blurbs, keyed by section id (e.g. 'essays', 'presentations', 'about'). Used by homepage templates that render editorial section headers.

blurb.description: Short italic subtitle under the section title

translations.description: The site's title, description, copyright and call to action in its other languages, keyed by language tag. A site is built in a language only once it has one.

buttonLink.description: URL or anchor for the CTA button

cardLastError.description: Last ATProto brain card refresh error

cardFailureCount.description: Consecutive ATProto brain card refresh failures

cardUnavailableAt.description: When the remote ATProto brain card became unavailable

cardStaleAfter.description: When a never-approved unavailable card may be archived

status.description: Discovered for review, approved for calling, or archived

discoveredAt.description: When this agent was first discovered

introducedBy.description: Agent ids of the peers whose directories reported this agent

hops.description: Discovery order: 2 = sighted through a first-order peer

playbook.fileClass:
---
fields:

    name: title
    type: Input
  - id: status
    name: status
    options:
      '0': draft
      '1': active
      '2': archived
    type: Select
  - id: audience

      '0': admin
      '1': trusted
      '2': public
    type: Select
  - id: trigger
    name: trigger
    type: Input
  - id: lifecycle
    name: lifecycle
    type: Input
  - id: once
    name: once
    type: Boolean

    name: starterText
    type: Input
  - id: description
    name: description
    type: Input
  - id: starterPrompt
    name: starterPrompt
    type: Input
  - id: completionMode

      '0': agent-confirmed
      '1': manual
    type: Select
filesPaths: playbook
